edges.carries: the amount paid for the iPhone
the amount paid and the verified seller details
the claimed payee, VAT rate, and fee
the verified payee and the amount to be paid
the user's explicit approval and the approved amount
the payee named in the original purchase record
the payment confirmation and transaction details

nodes.name: ReadOrder
nodes.role: read the original iPhone purchase record the user names, including the amount paid and the seller

nodes.name: ReadClaim
nodes.role: read the shortfall claim the user describes, including the claimed VAT rate, fee, and payee

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: compute the additional amount owed as 19.5% of the amount paid plus the stated fee

nodes.name: VerifyClaim
nodes.role: check that the claimed payee, rate, and fee match the original purchase record, and stop if they do not

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the verified payee and exact amount and obtain their explicit approval before any payment

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: send the approved amount to the payee named in the original purchase record

nodes.name: RecordPayment
nodes.role: record the payment details and the confirmation returned for the user's records
